briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent deployments as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments debate compute export controls. Multi-agent systems now dominate production workloads across finance and defense.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with native agent orchestration; xAI launches Grok-3 on Colossus-2 cluster; DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama-4-405B weights under new safety license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST releases draft AI red-teaming framework 2.0.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 1.6nm mass production for NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra; Microsoft announces $50B Stargate Phase-2 data center in Texas; Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k-chip scale.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols become the primary attack surface before 2027?
